# Vendor Evaluation Template

**Document ID:** TMP-VEND-002
**Version:** 1.0
**Status:** Template
**Published:** 2026-08-04

---

# Purpose

This template provides a standardized method for evaluating vendor performance following completion of maintenance, repair, inspection, or capital improvement work.

The objective is to create a consistent historical record of vendor performance that supports future vendor selection and continuous improvement.

Completed evaluations belong in the future Private Operations Repository.

# Usage Notes

Complete one Vendor Evaluation for every significant project.

Multiple evaluations over time provide a performance history that is far more valuable than a single overall rating.

---

# Guiding Principle

Evaluate the work—not the person.

Objective, consistent evaluations lead to better long-term vendor relationships and better property outcomes.
